name: @thoremin/music-formats
description: thoremin's music file formats: MIDI, MusicXML (and compressed .mxl) and ABC read into a ScoreDoc, a song written out as MIDI; each parser is its own module, meant to be reached by a dynamic import so it loads only when a file of its kind is opened; and the formatcast pack (`./pack`) that finds a file's format and loads its parser only then (TypeScript source, consumed through the workspace).
